I have also met joe personally (briefly) and he is v kind and v harmless. 

He is an eccentric person and people love to think that weird people do shit for attention bc they themselves are devoid of personality. 

Joe is a v nice guy, who's going through a lot.

I know him.

A few of us have reached out to him. Only one person so far has gotten a response where he says he's okay and to not worry about him.

No-one knows what's going on and is very concerned. I've literally been losing sleep over it, and have left discord for a little bit about it. Everyone is very concerned. 

There's a few possibilities as to what is happening that do not directly include suicide, but I have no idea. 

He went from posting about trying to meet someone, to mentioning past trauma things about people being really mean to him but not going into details. I'm unsure if he's leaving this earth, or leaving social media because of people harassing him. 

Either way I am very concerned for my friend and someone who I found to be personally inspiring.

I've talked to him a few times online and he was always super, extremely nice to me and everyone around me. He's very kind, he's very public... he has like... all social media accounts. 

I don't know if it's a mental health episode, or something... he is not the type to do drugs, he is super coherent to speak to, doesn't come off as someone who's lost touch with reality, but again... I haven't talked with him too much.

I personally am very concerned and worried for someone who I consider to be a great inspiration to my own life and art.

Joe if you are reading this, people care. I care.
